verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only programmatic client and server APIs for sign-up, sign-in, and sessions, such as authClient.signUp.email and auth.api methods. These are developer building blocks, not prebuilt customizable UI components or hosted sign-in, sign-up, or profile pages. No item in the pack mentions UI components, hosted pages, or profile-management screens, and prebuilt auth UI is a fair axis for an auth framework, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages
